lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The spatial density is higher in the anterior section immediately posterior to the head, with centroids exhibiting distortion due to surface water refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A small number of distinct, high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a prominent linear arrangement of spots along its leading edge.
